archival_memory.user_future_plans: I'm in my fourth year and the finish line for undergrad is finally in sight. I've changed my mindset from 'I'll figure out a direction eventually' to 'I need a solid plan or at least some prospective routes ASAP.' As a Computer Science major, there's pressure to land something right after graduation, whether that's a full-time job in industry, a spot in a grad program, or a startup venture. I'm currently leaning towards going into the industry for 5 years, but I haven't ruled out the possibility of grad school somewhere down the line.
